ios.desc:
Convert any 2D photo or video to 3D Spatial!
- Using our cutting-edge AI, step into photos and videos as if you're there
- Use the slider to add just the right amount of depth
- Trim videos before converting to select just what section you want
- Convert Spatial to VR side-by-side
- Batch convert entire folders and albums at once
- Save to Photos or Files to view alongside your other Spatial media
- Convert side-by-side and top-and-bottom VR media to Spatial

Convert on the go and send to your Vision Pro or Quest for viewing later.

quotes.text:
Built a free app to convert 2D photos to Spatial, directly on the Vision Pro.

Using CoreML and Metal to generate stereo images, RealityKit to display right in app, you can toss any image in and get a Spatial Photo that you can export to your Photos Library. Because processing is done entirely on the AVP, it's privacy preserving as well.

I've got Video working and will be releasing that soon (need visionOS 1.1 to come out to release it though!)

quotes.text:
An app that runs 2D to Spatial photo and video conversion directly on the Vision Pro. The app uses CoreML to run directly on device, generating a depth map and then stereo disparity for left+right images. On device processing preserves privacy.

It also converts other forms of VR content like side-bys-side and top-and-bottom in faster than real time.
